g.text: traces reaching step 3 in trace order
A counter observes only that an 'agent.validate' span EXISTS somewhere in a trace. It has no
notion of position, so it scores a run identically whether validate ran after tool (the
contract) or before it (a violation). Aggregating per-span and then dividing discards the
per-trace join entirely; no amount of extra GROUP BY columns recovers it, because ordering is
a property of the trace, not of the span.
contain an 'agent.validate' span that fires at or before 'tool'.
